METTAWA, Ill. , Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Brunswick Corporation (NYSE: BC), today, released its third quarter 2026 financial results. A complete and full-text financial results press release is available on the Company’s website at[https://www.brunswick.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=iGQGPQd9UB52WW8lP1j9_xRPXw2iIXoE5dB3I-Rsae4Sg2N6xV3DcpS8vF-WO_gfKSUqK9ZM6jdwibDIKLm94kMA0C6u3N5QP-HmpkiSwUk=) .


The results will also be available on the SEC’s website with the[Form 8-K filing of the release](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=6ZFy8WMW1_3yaLuVpJxdpphn5--tVGP2Xuu3hn_28dg_IlMmWVwUxmDuhFjUmy5jvrGUI9MUIemmHJAMtoqDz144qJ9R4Zc_xXKm7rS3jB2MclKD0rUTKIzJ7EAQsEvSHRp9MOnrLGIJ02h1ZxZAS4FFoV5VPF1qd8uSFOWR_G3Q5s2VnwedmbH9Dzr2_C8KgmlXaz7gHEphfqR3-t3rqw==) .


The Company will hold a conference call today at 10 a.m. CT / 11 a.m. ET, Thursday, October 29, 2026, hosted by David M. Foulkes, chairman and chief executive officer, Ryan M. Gwillim, executive vice president, chief financial officer, and chief strategy officer, Aine Denari, executive vice president, president Navico Group, and Brunswick chief technology officer, and Stephen Weiland, senior vice president, finance, and deputy CFO. A copy of the presentation to be used on this call will be available when the results are released as noted above.


The webcast can be accessed at Brunswick.com and here:[Webcast | Brunswick Corporation Q3 2026 Earnings Conference Call](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0K4DAKTLTeZUONfxFJsRsYBd_9Ja_9igsWSz0fuxUtsKs6iusQwraSy5Ya_18UPBMj_ORSZa4N8kYXVRydA3gPyaRRU3Pu5E2YM8Hzz9wS538BSAd-WnTUmDtmC8w3VW23HLYTskYwTgu0luNVc4CKb-ET5dz4s_cVHiDUJaTqowemrVqMNGJpsr0t_py24kGWe6CMlKuEXmky6LwHLmtmWLihGIX41dBXpXqBgQvR5ZriJUJ6Yn9GFQ47OxppI2) . A replay of the conference call will be available through 1 p.m. CT Thursday November 5, 2026, at the same link.


**About Brunswick Corporation**


Brunswick Corporation (NYSE: BC) is a global leader in marine recreation, delivering innovation that transforms experiences on the water and beyond. Its technology-driven solutions are informed by deep consumer insights and guided by the belief that “Next Never Rests™.” Brunswick is home to more than 60 industry-leading brands across marine propulsion (including Mercury Marine), parts and accessories (including Attwood), and marine electronics (including Simrad and Lowrance), as well as boat brands including Boston Whaler, Sea Ray, Bayliner, Lund, and Harris. Headquartered in Mettawa, Illinois, Brunswick has approximately 14,000 employees operating in 26 countries. Learn more at Brunswick.com.
